summary: Hiker attempting to summit Pikes Peak failed to reach the top, spent the night on the mountain, and became cliffed out; El Paso County Search and Rescue rappelled to the hiker and rescued the person Tuesday afternoon; condition not reported.
responding_agency: El Paso County Search and Rescue
notes: Source: Backpacker roundup published Mon 2019-08-26 covering Aug 19-26; 'Tuesday afternoon' = Aug 20, the only Tuesday in the window, Tuesday-verified. Linked CBS Denver drone-footage page not openable; condition unknown. Inserted run 1014 (EPSO chunk).
